pr_title: clisqlclient: omit VC name from CLI prompt if only system VC is present
pr_body:
Previously, we would always show the name of the virtual cluster that CLI is connected to in the prompt. However, this is quite confusing in case the cluster doesn't have any secondary VCs, so this commit omits the name from the prompt in that case.

Fixes: #113997.

Release note: None

issue_context.title: cli: consider not showing "system" prefix for single-tenant deployments
issue_context.body:
Currently, when starting cockroach process in a single tenant mode, the CLI shell has "system" in the prompt
```
root@127.0.0.1:26257/system/defaultdb
```
This is confusing. We should consider showing the tenant name only when there is at least one application tenant created.

Jira issue: CRDB-33289

Hi @yuzefovich, please add branch-* labels to identify which branch(es) this release-blocker affects.

review_comments:
I suppose the other case in which it might be empty is if we are talking to a serverless cluster where I think we may still have some tenants with no name field.  We've made such tenants very hard to produce in 23.1. I do think this points out another potential behaviour difference because of this change. Namely, in CC I think some people will get VC names in their shell and others won't depending on when their tenant was created.  It's potentially also true that some people will see `tenant-%d` (the old naming scheme) while some will see `cluster-%d` the new naming scheme.  Maybe we can fix this by renaming a bunch of tenants in serverless. 

I don't think this needs to block this PR. Just something we might need to figure out with CC.
